gap: No result ChatGPT got works out the cost per cell. Tenergy's own store sells the same Solla 1,000 mAh cell at $1.08 each in the 24-pack ($25.99), against $1.42 each in the 12-pack ChatGPT showed ($16.99). The Solla Premium 1,300 mAh costs $1.37–$1.81 a cell, and Lightalent's 600 mAh pack costs $0.83 a cell on Amazon.
standout_why: I read the cited Tenergy Solla 1000 page. It lists the 24-pack ($25.99) as a related item but gives no per-cell figure and no comparison. I also read the cited idealgardenlights.com guide, which names no brands, prices or per-cell costs. Of the top results, solarpatiolights.net lists Tenergy Solla 1000 at $13.99 for 12, EBL at $9.99 for 12 and PKCELL at $5.49 for 4, but gives no per-cell math and no pack sizes. geekchamp.com lists Amazon prices for EBL, Kruta, WENJOOP, Howardly and JiajaX but has no cost-per-cell comparison and leaves out Tenergy. Rivals carry some of the prices, but none of them gives the per-cell math or the maker-store price for each pack size. Our current page already shows the 24-for-$25.99 and 8-for-$14.49 options.
decides: This confirms Tenergy Solla 1000 as the pick and changes which pack to buy. If you have more than about 12 lights, the 24-pack costs 24% less per cell than the 12-pack ChatGPT showed. The Solla Premium 1300 has the same rated 2,000 cycles and the same -4 to 122 °F range, but costs $0.29–$0.73 more per cell than the Solla 1000 24-pack. It only makes sense if your light came with a cell above 1,000 mAh. Lightalent 600 mAh is the cheapest cell I could price ($0.83), but at 600 mAh it only fits lights that came with 600 mAh cells.
